descriptionHtml:
缺陷 A2 · P2 · 无障碍

状态和错误不播报：报错、无搜索结果、Ask AI 的回答、「Listening…」都不读出来；开关没有选中 / 按下状态

票：TFA-94745 等 · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：本地（视觉巡检）

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：EFS/S22, TC-03/S22, TC-10/S23, TC-15/S19, TC-23/S18, TC-09/S23

思路 / Approach · OAT-03 Retry/Timeout Resiliency · S22 「失败和离线状态通过 axe，并且会被读出来」 Failure and offline states pass axe and are announced

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U2 If retries are exhausted, an explicit failure message appears (matching the prototype's 'NOTE NOT GENERATED' pattern; EFS: 'Note not generated' shown), never a blank note, a crash, a raw error pop-up …（UAT OAT-03 step 3；UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 1；UAT Empty & Failure States (Note generation failed)；TFA-94745 state 4；TFA-94745 AC 1；TFA-94745 AC 2；TFA-94422 AC 5；TFA-92568 AC 5）
  • T2 Each error tells the physician what to do next (retry, check connection, enable permission, sign in) in plain language in the app's existing style（TFA-94745 AC 5；TFA-94745 AC 1）
  • U9 Offline / no network: a clear 'no network' message; dictation kept and retried when the connection returns, so dropped hospital Wi-Fi does not lose a physician's dictation（UAT Empty & Failure States (Offline / no network)；UAT OAT-03 Source；TFA-94745 state 9）

测试设计方法：无障碍（accessibility） — 按读屏、键盘、对比度、点按尺寸的规则（axe）查，残障用户也要能用。

Given Visual lane with each state on screen: generation failure (both contexts), billing retry button, Ask AI error, no-network banner, scan error

When Run axe on each state

Then No serious or critical WCAG 2 A/AA violations; the message sits in a status or alert region so a screen reader hears it; the retry control is a named button reachable by keyboard

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：axe-core: zero serious/critical; role=status or role=alert on the message container (ConnectionBanner already renders role="status"); keyboard Tab reaches the retry

在哪跑：本地 visual lane（截图 + axe）；测试方法 VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看）；矩阵里排的车道 视觉 / 移动端（blocked）

S22 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-03.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：无障碍 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92568 in progress；TFA-94422 ready for qa；TFA-94745 ready for qa

「The photo couldn't be read…」这条照片识别错误在两种模式下都不会被读屏播报，这些失败页面还有严重的对比度问题。

The scan error 'The photo couldn't be read…' is not announced to screen readers in either mode, and these failure screens have serious contrast failures.

依据：allure 2c3f0815-…-result.json; runs/2026-10-14-local/visual/evidence/OAT-03_S22: 85 checks pass, 30 fail. Generation-failure, billing, Ask AI and offline messages are in role=alert/status, and the retry buttons are named and reached by Tab (desktop, Pixel 7). The scan-error part is the same defect as in EFS/S22 (counted there too). Recorded only: a 'Chart access couldn't be recorded' banner appeared once in the pre-review run under shared-stack load; it is likely a test-environment artifact and is unconfirmed.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane visual。

测试方法：VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看）；辅助：FAULT · 故障注入 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：visual。

UAT item: OAT-03 Retry/Timeout Resiliency · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-03/S22

Failure and offline states pass axe and are announced

Tickets: TFA-92568 Phase 4: Make it safe for real patients (in progress); TFA-94422 Haiku primary, Mistral fallback via Bedrock (ready for qa); TFA-94745 Empty & Failure States (ready for qa)

本地新 lane visual：visual/results.json 里 status failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 标了产品问题））。

怎么测（visual/plan.json，automatable: yes）：failure.spec.ts: generation failure (both contexts), billing retry (Hospital), Ask AI error (both), scan error (both) and the offline banner; axe serious/critical = 0, message in role=alert/status, retry is a named button reached by Tab (desktop, Pixel 7). [2026-10-14 review] Generate is pressed in the generation-failure states: ai/notes:generateNote is answered 'fail' at the socket, so nothing reaches the backend and no model is called. — All socket-injected; keyboard reach not checked on iPhone WebKit (Tab skips buttons by default) and recorded so.

Detail:

desktop, iphone15, pixel7: 85 judged check(s) passed, 30 failed. Generation failure (both), billing retry (Hospital), Ask AI error (both), scan error (both), offline banner: failure messages in role=alert/status except the scan error; retry controls are named buttons reached by Tab on desktop and Pixel 7 (not checked on iPhone WebKit, recorded). Generate is pressed in the generation-failure states with ai/notes:generateNote answered 'fail' at the socket (no model call).

产品问题：The scan failure 'The photo couldn’t be read. Check your connection and try again, or retake the photo.' is not announced (no role=alert/status) in either context; plus serious contrast failures on these screens (oracle: zero serious/critical, message in a status or alert region).

只记录的格子（recorded）：Pre-review run only (iterations/pre-review/evidence/OAT-03_S22/desktop--nh-scan-error.json): a red 'Chart access couldn’t be recorded. Check your connection and reload.' banner was on screen once, with nothing deleted, while the shared local backend was under other jobs' load; not seen in the post-review run on any profile. Likely the access-log mutation timing out under load (a test-environment artifact), unconfirmed.

证据：附了 7 个；没附 1 个：

  • visual/evidence/OAT-03_S22 — 目录（51 项），不附

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane V: visual-lane.ts reads a make-session.ts fixture (a fresh local account made with the admin key), and the failure states are forced with socket failFirst, setOffline and a scan fixture; make-session.ts refuses dev and dev has no action mock, so it runs on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10…. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
